Introducing the CHERI Adoption Global Ecosystem Assessment Q1 2026
Introducing the CHERI Adoption Global Ecosystem Assessment Q1 2026

In 2025 alone, global cybercrime costs reached an estimated $1.2 billion every minute, with projections rising to $1.8 billion per minute by 2029. Just seven years earlier, the figure was “only” $100 million per minute—already enormous, but now…

13 May 2026
CHERI Alliance news
Ecosystem
Working Groups

Adam Finney – CHERI Alliance

The CHERI Alliance is pleased to publish the CHERI Adoption Global Ecosystem Assessment Q1 2026, a new report examining the current state of CHERI adoption across industry, research, government, and open communities.

CHERI is gaining increasing attention as organisations look for practical ways to address memory safety, strengthen cyber resilience, and build security into the foundations of computing. As interest grows, so does the need for a clearer picture of where the ecosystem stands today and what may be needed to support wider adoption.

This assessment brings together evidence from public sources, stakeholder engagement, ecosystem activity, and technical developments to provide a structured view of the global CHERI landscape.

Rather than treating CHERI as a purely academic technology or a future possibility, the report considers its emerging role in real world systems, supply chains, standards, policy discussions, and secure by design strategies.

The report is intended to help decision makers, technologists, policymakers, researchers, and industry participants understand the direction of travel and the practical considerations that will shape the next phase of CHERI adoption.

The CHERI Adoption Global Ecosystem Assessment Q1 2026 is now available from the CHERI Alliance.
